description: This file provides testing codecs for Kubernetes API objects, including functions to obtain codecs based on environment variables, and utility functions to create runtime schemes and codec factories for testing purposes.

methods.name: TestCodec
methods.description: Returns the appropriate codec for the API version to test against, based on environment variable KUBE_TEST_API_TYPE.

methods.name: TestStorageCodec
methods.description: Returns the storage codec for the API version to test against, based on environment variable KUBE_TEST_API_STORAGE_TYPE.

methods.name: SchemeForInstallOrDie
methods.description: Creates a runtime scheme and codec factory for testing, applying provided install functions.

methods.name: SchemeForOrDie
methods.description: Creates a runtime scheme and codec factory for testing, applying provided install functions that may return errors.
